result.stdout:
Check local HNSW startup fast-forward and integrity hazards

Usage: vecturadb hnsw-integrity-check [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --path <DIR>
          Chroma persistent directory [default: ./chroma]
      --sqlite <FILE>
          Sqlite database path; defaults to <path>/chroma.sqlite3
      --collection <UUID>
          Limit the check to one collection
      --log-tenant <LOG_TENANT>
          Configured SQLite log tenant ID [default: default]
      --log-topic-namespace <LOG_TOPIC_NAMESPACE>
          Configured SQLite log topic namespace [default: default]
      --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help
          Print help

Run against a stopped Chroma instance for a consistent view of SQLite and index files. A hot SQLite rollback journal requires recovery and causes this read-only check to fail; recover a copy of the stopped store, including its SQLite sidecar files, and check that copy. Exit codes: 0 = no corruption or pending migration; 1 = findings; 2 = check failed.

result.stdout:
Repair invalid local HNSW construction settings in a new copy

Usage: vecturadb hnsw-config-repair --path <PATH> --output <OUTPUT> --collection <COLLECTION> --ef-construction <EF_CONSTRUCTION>

Options:
      --path <PATH>
          Persistent directory of a stopped Chroma instance. Never modified
      --output <OUTPUT>
          New persistent directory, outside the source directory. Must not exist
      --collection <COLLECTION>
          Collection whose invalid ef_construction values should be repaired
      --ef-construction <EF_CONSTRUCTION>
          Replacement for values outside 1..=4096; valid values are preserved
  -h, --help
          Print help
